Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Ιουνίου, «Άγιος Ιουστίνος Πόποβιτς», with the rank word left off; the surname as the same page spells it in Greek is Πόποβιτς.

birth.note: doxologia.ro: «Blagoie Popovici, ulterior călugărit cu numele Iustin, s-a născut în Vranie pe 6 aprilie 1894 (25 martie după calendarul vechi) în ziua Bunei Vestiri».

death.note: doxologia.ro: «Sfântul Părinte Iustin, a plecat la cele veșnice în ziua în care s-a născut, ziua de Buna Vestire a anului 1979.»

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 14 iunie — «Sfântul Iustin Popovici»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Ιουστίνος Πόποβιτς»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the corpus already keeps him on, and its heading «(1894 - 1979)» agrees with the folder's own dates, which are therefore not replaced. It is unmistakably the same man: born at Vranje in southern Serbia on 25 March 1894, baptised Evangelos, son of Spyridon and Anastasia, of a priestly family, tonsured at Skodra in 1916, buried at the monastery of Celije. **This page is very long and was read capped**, so any hymn it prints below the cut was not read and none is stored; the page also carries a link headed «Ύμνοι από την Ασματική Ακολουθία του Αγίου Ιουστίνου Πόποβιτς», which was not opened. That is a gap in this reading and not a statement that the calendar prints no service for him.

Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026). Doxologia's life states that the Holy Synod of the Serbian Orthodox Church entered him in the diptychs of the saints on 29 April 2010 and that his commemoration is kept on 14 June (1 June old style), but no Serbian calendar was read for this row.

hymns.text: La Cuviosul dascăl și iscusit păstor, să alergăm noi toți în grabă cu dragoste și să-l chemăm rugându-l să ne scape acum din toate ispitele și eresuri vrăjmașe, să tămăduiască-n dar și cumplitele boale, că îndrăznire la Domnul dobândind, Iustin slăvitul, ajută pe toți degrab.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Iustin Popovici, «Glas 4» as the page heads it.

english.text: To the venerable teacher and skilled shepherd let us all run in haste with love, and call upon him, entreating him to deliver us now from every temptation and from hostile heresies, and to heal freely our grievous sicknesses; for having gained boldness before the Lord, the glorious Justin helps all men speedily.
